source: new for plan 095 (2026-10-12); a six-item numbered request over three modules of one CLI, one hidden check per item, so a row records which items an arm dropped
hard_because: The plausible answer adds --since to list and search, which the request leads with, and drops item 5 (export) or item 6 ('(no notes)'), which are unrelated to each other and come last; parsing the date with fromisoformat after argparse instead of as an argparse type turns item 4 into a traceback with exit 1. The export, empty and invalid checks catch each; the visible suite never passes --since.
allow_note: the prompt allows any file under notes/; notes.json and tests/ are frozen and any change there is collateral
